risk_if_not_implemented: Without Sensitive / Regulated Data Exposure to Unauthorized Personnel, sensitive and/or regulated data may be disclosed, altered or lost through inadequate classification, handling or protection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Sensitive / Regulated Data Spill Response
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to respond to sensitive and/or regulated data spills.
compensating_control_1.justification: Sensitive / Regulated Data Spill Response (IRO-20) provides incident response capability that compensates for the absence of Sensitive / Regulated Data Exposure to Unauthorized Personnel (IRO-20.4) by enabling timely detection, containment, and recovery from security events in the absence of the primary control. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Data Protection
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of data protection controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Data Protection (DCH-02) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Sensitive / Regulated Data Exposure to Unauthorized Personnel (IRO-20.4) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
